summary: Massive rockslide (approx 100-ton boulders) buried a family of six at the Agnes Vaille Falls viewing area; five killed, one 13-year-old girl survived with a broken leg and was airlifted to a Denver hospital
location: Agnes Vaille Falls, Chalk Creek Canyon, below Mount Princeton
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff; U.S. Forest Service
notes: 5 fatalities; 1 injured survivor airlifted; bodies recovered a day later due to unstable conditions
